ChatGPT Read Aloud Saver includes lamejs 1.2.1, an MP3 encoder by Dmitry Zhukov and contributors, derived from LAME / jump3r.

Project: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.net/
Upstream package: https://registry.npmjs.org/lamejs/-/lamejs-1.2.1.tgz

lame.min.js is bundled as a separate, unmodified library under the LGPL. Its upstream LICENSE is included as LAMEJS-LICENSE.txt. The complete source package is included as lamejs-1.2.1-source.tgz (including its COPYING and LICENSE files), with the release cleanup described below. You may modify or replace the library in this unpacked extension subject to its license.

Source-package cleanup (2026-10-01):
- Only package/src/main/java/mp3/LameTest.java was edited: four machine-specific path literals now use testdata/440880.wav (two occurrences), testdata/c00.wav, and generated_java.mp3. A dated source comment documents this change. These external sample fixtures were not included upstream and remain user-supplied.
- Archive file timestamps and numeric owner/group identifiers were normalized to zero; owner/group names are blank. The gzip wrapper contains no timestamp, original filename, or comment.
- All other source files, bundled sample data, copyright notices, and licenses retain their original contents. The runtime encoder is unchanged.

The extension loads the bundled library locally. It does not load encoder code or send audio to a remote service at runtime.
